title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba would play for free, but wants to be highest-paid WR

sources.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba would play for free, but wants to be highest-paid WR
sources.description: Jaxon Smith-Njigba isn't in a rush for a contract extension with the Seahawks, but wants to be the highest-paid receiver when it happens.
